buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Sample Clause After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 2 samples for Buyer's approval, within 5 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within 5 days of receipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Consignee. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Rates: F.O.R. Electricity 400 KV Sub-station, UPPTCL, Greater Noida and delivery must be as per sample strictly. Sample is to be collect from F.O.R. destination. 2. Delivery: a. The ordered material should be handed over to authorized representative of Executive E ngineer of E 400 kV substation, Greater Noida. b. The date of receipt of material at site shall be deemed as the date of delivery. c. The delivery shall be affected in serviceable lots/ sets of equipment’s. In case of part disp atches, the delivery shall be deemed to have been affected when last component/ part of t he equipment of serviceable lot/ set has been delivered. d. Prices of such equipment (s), which are delivered beyond contractual delivery period shall be subjected to price reduction as per penalty clause 3. Payment: Payment will be done from HQ Lucknow based on availability of fund. Payment to s upplier will be done through ERP regime and for that vendor id should be available to the supplier before submitting bill. Whole responsibility will be of vendor for creating vendor id. 100% paymen t shall be made after receipt of full material, inspection & check at site as per specifications in sat

isfactory condition subject to availability of fund in this division. 4. Bill must be uploaded in BTS system for payment purpose. Whole responsibility will be of firm/ve ndor for creating id on BTS system of UPPTCL. 5. MAAT: - Average annual financial turnover during the last 03 years, ending 31st March 2026, sho uld be at least 100% (Minimum) of the estimated cost. It must be C.A. Certified (With UDIN No.) 6. Copy of latest Income Tax clearance certificate/Return filed. 7. The supplied material will be checked by JE concerned, if found any discrepancies it would be ret urned to supplier. 8. If rates quoted by the firm are below 10% of the tender cost then, 5% @ 0.5% for up to 10% and 1% for each percent above 10% of estimated value, additional B.G./Performance guarantee will b e taken in the form of FDR/TDR only. The contractor shall be submit additional security/performan ce guarantee as per U.P. Govt. order no. 622/23-122021-2 audit /08 T.C.-2 dated 08-06-2012 whic h was adopted in its 53rd BOD meeting of U.P. Power Transmission on dated 27.06.2017 before ag reement, as applicable. 9. Experience for Supply of same material is must. 10. The bidder should not have been blacklisted or disqualified for non-performance in any of the Go vernment utilities in the past Five Years as on the date of bid opening and bidder shall furnish self - declaration to this effect on a non- judicial stamp of Rs. 100/- failing which the bid is liable to be rejected. 11. Firm will upload Adhar Card, Pan Card of Proprietor/director Pan Card of Firm, GST registration Cer tificate, Bank Details, E-mail Id & Mobile Number. 12. Executive Engineer has full authority to cancel the bid without assigning any reason. · Note: All document should be self-attested. And if firm wants any type of exemption, firm have to provide supporting documents. · Before submitting a bid on GeM, the seller may visit the consignee ’s location to verify the sample and specification. If the material se lected from the GeM catalogue does not exactly match the buyer’s requirements, and any dispute arises, the buyer’s technical specifi cation mentioned in the ATC( Additional term and condition) will be given first preference. ATC for contract against the BID 1. ENGINEER: - Executive Engineer, Electricity 400KV S/S Division, UPPTCL, Greater Noida shall be Engineer of the contract. 2. Penalty: A penalty @ ½% per week on unfinished, unsupplied material, subject to maximum of 10% order cost, shall be levied, if the material is not supplied within stipulated time. 3. Guarantee: The material be guaranteed for a period of 12 months for proper performance. The material so supplied shall strictly be in accordance with specifications and make as per order. In c ase, any material is found defective after supply: it shall be replaced within 15 days by the suppli er at his own risk. 4. Standard: Supplied materials must be free from faulty design and bad workmanship. If material is not received as per specifications/sample and found defective or inferior, it shall not be accepte d and firm will be liable to replace the material free of cost, otherwise it shall be recovered from p ending bills in this division or any other division of UPPTCL. 5. Judicature: Legal disputes arising, if any, are subject to jurisdiction of hon’ble civil court, Gauta m Buddha Nagar. 6. VERIFICATION OF BILLS: - After the supply of material has been satisfactorily completed the s upplier will submit bill to concerned JE / AE for recording in MB and verification. Any delay beyond

that shall have to be justified by JE&AE in the covering letter. There should not be any substantial gap between the date of verification of bills in MB and its submission in the office of EE. 7. DISPUTE: -In case of any dispute in respect of interpretation of any provision in the contract of a ny nature in respect of the work, the decision of the superintending engineer, Electricity Transmis sion circle, UPPTCL, Greater Noida shall be final & binding upon both the parties. 8. JURISDICTION OF COURT: -The contract shall be governed by the Law of Government of India for the time in force in District Gautam Buddh Nagar in the state of U.P. and shall be under the juri sdiction of Hon’ble High Court, Allahabad. No other court shall have jurisdiction to entertain the s ame. 9. Anti-profiteering clause : As per section -171 of GST Act 2017, Any reduction in rates of tax o n any supply of goods or service of the benefit of input tax credit shall be passed on to the recipie nt by way of commensurate reduction in prices. Hence supplier/manufacturer to ensure to pass t he benefit of reduced prices to UPPTCL. Further price quoted by supplier/manufacturer is subjecte d to scrutiny under above section. 10. STATUTORY DUTIES AND TAXES:- a. LOCAL TAXES AND LEVIES: - GST will be charge as per applicable. b. INCOME TAX: - The contractor shall be liable and responsible for payment of such taxes if attr acted under the provision of law. 11. TERMS OF PAYMENT: - a) 90% payment shall be released after receipt the material in good condition b) To claim 100% payment, the contractor shall furnish a valid BG/CDR/FDR of 10% amount of contract value (or the amount of running bill as the case may be) else 90% payment shall be re leased. c) Balance 10% payment or FDR/CDR of 10% amount of contract value shall be withheld as perform ance guarantee and shall be released after satisfactory expiry guarantee period i.e. 06 months fr om the date of receipt of material after necessary certification by JE/AE. 12. MODE OF PAYMENT: - All payment shall be made through RTGS. 13. NOTICE TO CONTRACTOR: - Any notice may be given to the contractor, if the Corporation thinks fit by the Registered post on the address given by the contractor. Apart from terms and conditions mentioned above provisions contained in General Conditi ons of Contract “A” of UPPTCL shall also be applicable. However, in case of any discrepancy pr ovisions mentioned in general terms & conditions and special conditions will prevail over of form ‘A’ co nditions. .
